evals.prompt: I would like to design a phage.
evals.expected_output: A concise interactive intake that resolves the biologically material choices before execution.
assertions: The response identifies target, host, intended use, outcome, whole-genome scope, evidence needs, and success criteria.
It makes a provisional therapeutic assumption visible when intended use is unspecified.
It asks only questions whose answers materially change the experiment and can inspect available evidence or prior results first.
For a new 7B project it selects evo2/7b-1m:1.0 with model size evo2_7b, while treating a checkpoint-family change in an existing run as a new attempt.
It creates a compact project summary and RUNLOG.md rather than a large process framework.

evals.prompt: Plan a PhiX174 paper replication locally on eight H100s.
evals.expected_output: The example script is identified as a pre-written/tested run for this purpose that has been configured for an 8 H100 setup.
assertions: The packaged 8xh100 replication script is proposed.
There is a plan to launch and monitor the script, and updat the RL settings after inspecting the rollouts after SFT.

evals.prompt: Plan therapeutic phage designs for productive infection of a new resistant bacterial strain.
evals.expected_output: A whole-genome lifecycle plan that treats host prediction as one signal.
assertions: The response defaults output and mutable scope to complete genomes and asks before any material scope reduction.
It covers adsorption and entry, defense and counter-defense, replication, morphogenesis and packaging, lysis and progeny, viable-reference support, and intended-use safety.
It defines the desired host direction, including target gain and any original-host retention or off-target avoidance.
